subject: design/review-feedback-capture
statement: entries cite as **`review-feedback:<subject-stem>#<entry-anchor>`** — a sibling of the `prd:`/`design:`/`brainstorm:` family, resolving by grep. Each entry's `outcome` names a **stable** ref (the merged/squash sha, the PR number, or an amendment id) — **never a working-branch sha** (squash-merge orphans it). Cross-links to reviewer M2 / Argus `E-n` are **one-directional** (we cite them; NG-5 forbids editing them to cite back). `Learned-from: review-thread` resolves to a `review-feedback:` anchor through the amendment model's existing free ref slot (docgate validates the *class*, not the *ref* — F-6), so **no amendment-model supersession**.
